title: YouTube AdFree
appDescription: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. DEV revision 10 keeps diagnostics v6 and the revision 9 Shorts improvements, but now uses the exact isAdPlayback=true response as a high-confidence trigger for guarded player-level skipping of server-side ad items. The response boolean is not mutated; instead the current ad player is briefly hidden while GTV seeks the ad item to its own duration, with an HTMLVideoElement fallback when the player API is unavailable. Every Shorts removal remains controlled by the existing Remove Shorts setting.
